slides.head:
Hollywood made the OpenAI movie.
It opens Christmas Day.
Artificial.
slides.body: Directed by Luca Guadagnino. The story of how OpenAI and ChatGPT began.

slides.head: The cast.
slides.body: Andrew Garfield as Sam Altman. Ike Barinholtz as Elon Musk. Monica Barbaro as Mira Murati. Yura Borisov as Ilya Sutskever.

slides.head:
Amazon passed.
NEON picked it up.
slides.body: Amazon MGM let the film go. Amazon has $50 billion invested in OpenAI. NEON paid about $40 million, per Variety.
